responsibility: Implements the structural tree graph dumper that prints raw tree nodes with stable numeric references rather than source-like syntax. It manages the queued traversal of tree nodes, assigns indices, prints node headers and selected fields according to dump flags, follows child references while avoiding repeated output, and serves debugging and internal inspection needs distinct from the pretty-printer by exposing tree layout, sharing, and node identity.
same_name_distinction: Contains the structural tree dumper implementation behind gcc/tree-dump.h, managing the node queue, stable numbering, field emission, and traversal/output of tree graphs; the header only defines dump_info/dump_queue support types, flags, macros, and primitive interfaces.
